tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun las: bka' srung dregs pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs:

ྈྈྈ he ru ka dpal dregs pa 'dul byed la: phyag 'tshal de yi sgrub thabs bstan par bya: bstan pa bsrung phyir bstan srung sgrub pa ni: 'jig rten mchod cing bstod pas 'grub par gsungs: de phyir shin tu rtsub pa'i gnas rnams su: dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing sgrub thabs mchod pa dang: spyan gzigs tshogs rnams 'dus shing 'tshogs par bya: sngon 'gro'i rim pa spyi ltar byas nas su: dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni: chos rnams dmigs med kun khyab de bzhin nyid: 'gag med rang rtsal snying rjes kun la khyab: zung 'jug rgyu yi snying po hūm̐ yig las: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros snod bcud dngos po sbyangs: dwangs ma e yaṃ ra suṃ kiṃ raṃ 'phros: nam mkha' rlung nag khrag mtsho zhing gi sa: keṃ rus ri rab bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar: de dbus bhrūm̐ las drag po'i pho brang ni: thod pa rim brtsegs khrag zhag me rlung 'khrugs: dregs pa nyi zla'i ka gdung rgyan gyis mdzes: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i bam gyi longs spyod can: gru bzhi sgo bzhi zhing gis thog phub cing: tsitta'i tog 'bar gnam lcags 'khor lo 'khor: chu srin phru gu nya sbrul zar tshags can: dur khrod brgyad dang srung ba'i 'khor los bskor: gru chad 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rdo rje brag: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i e dbyings su: padma nyi zla dregs pa pho mo'i gdan: de steng rgyu yi sa bon hūm̐ yig bab: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: bdag nyid gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul ni: mthing nag g.yas pa kham nag g.yon smug zhal: phyag drug dang po'i rdo rjes dung khrag dkrug: g.yas kyi bar ma tha mas lha brgyad mgo: g.yon gyi bar pa 'og mas klu brgyad mgo: skra nas 'dzin cing rdo rje'i gshog pa brgyangs: khro gnyer rab bsdus spyan dgu glog ltar 'khyug: sma ra smin ma kham nag gyen du 'bar: dbu skra dmar ser gyen 'khyil rdo rje'i tog:

gar dgu'i nyams ldan khrag zhag thal bas byugs: zhing chen ko rlon sku yi stod du gsol: stag lpags sham thabs rdo rje'i go khrab dang: sbrul chun thod pa'i cod pan do shal dang: 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyan gyis rab tu bklubs: zhabs bzhi rol pa'i stabs kyis dregs pa brdzis: gsang ba'i yum chen srid pa spyi 'dul ma: mthing nag phyag rgya lnga 'chang dur khrod chas: kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khril: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs: yab yum rdo rje padma mnyam sbyor bas: byang chub sems sprin khro bo'i tshogs spros pas: dregs pa tshar bcad tshur 'dus hūm̐ la bsdus: yab yum mkha' gsang lam nas phyir 'phros pas: g.yas su lha chen dbang phyug sku mdog mthing: g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas tsitta 'dzin: ber nag gsol nas 'jigs byed seng ge 'chib: g.yon du u ma de wī sku mdog mthing: g.yas pas rtse gsum g.yon pas thod khrag 'dzin: ber nag gsol nas glang po che la 'chib: phyogs bzhi 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng du: shar du ya ma rā dza sku mdog nag: g.yas pas be con g.yon pas thod dbyug thogs: gcan gzan lpags pa gsol nas ma he 'chib: sgrol byed nag mo 'khor lo thod khrag 'dzin: mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol nas chu glang 'chib: lho ru bdud po skos rje brang dkar nag: g.yas pas khram shing g.yon pas thod khrag thogs: ber nag gsol nas bdud rta nag po 'chib: re tī nag mo mthing nag ber chen gsol: khram shing thod khrag 'dzin cing bong bu 'chib: nub tu srin po glog gi phreng ba can: nag po g.yas g.yon glog phreng ser ba thogs: glog gi thul pa gsol nas 'brug la 'chib: klu mo sbal mgo khrag mig khrag gi mdog: phyag g.yas phur pa g.yon pas mi mgo 'dzin: ber nag gsol nas rnga mong 'jigs la 'chib: byang du gnod sbyin yaksha me dbal nag: g.yas pas rin po che dang g.yon zangs gri:

me phung gsol nas gcan gzan stag la 'chib: gnod sbyin sngon mo spu gri g.yu spyang thogs: ber nag gsol nas lcags kyi phag nag zhon: shar dbus gnam thel dkar po shel gri dang: shel mdung dar dkar ba dan can 'dzin nas: za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol rta dkar 'chib: lho dbus sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ma: nag mo tsitta g.yas la g.yu spyang g.yon: mthing gi gos can drel rta nag mo 'chib: nub dbus btsan rgyal srog zan sku mdog dmar: mda' gzhu mdung dmar thogs nas me rta 'chib: dar dmar ral gu bse rmog dmar po gsol: byang dbus gu lang kā la nag po ni: g.yas pas kha ṭwāṃ g.yon pas thod khrag 'thung: dar nag ber chen gsol nas seng ge 'chib: shar stod sham po dkar po dar dkar gsol: mdung dar shel gri 'dzin cing g.yag dkar zhon: shar smad spyi bdud rgyal po gu rum dkar: shel khrab bse rmog gsol nas mdung dar thogs: rdo rta gro bo rdzu 'phrul 'phur shes 'chib: lho stod ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo dkar: dar dkar gos can 'khor lo me long thogs: g.yu 'brug sngon po ral pa can la 'chib: lho smad mkha' 'gro mgyogs byed sku mdog nag: phyag gnyis rgyu zhags tshon gyi gru gu thogs: za 'og nag po'i gos can bya rog zhon: nub stod ru ṭa rdo rje bdud 'dul nag: phyag gnyis yungs thun bhandha khrag bkang 'dzin: dar nag ber gsol rta nag rlung gshog 'chib: nub smad yam shud dmar po gri zhags thogs: ber dmar gsol nas zangs rta dmar po zhon: byang stod bi nā ya ka mthing nag mdog: g.yas pas kha ṭwāṃ g.yon pas thod khrag thogs: dar nag ber chen gsol nas rta nag 'chib: byang smad bkrag med nag po ber nag gsol: shang lang mda' gzhu thogs nas rta nag zhon: steng phyogs gza' bdud dud kha mgo dgu pa: bya rog zhal can mig stong sbrul mjug can: 'brug slog gsol nas g.yas pas mda' gzhu dang: g.yon pas sbrul zhags 'phen cing 'brug la zhon:

gnam sman thog gi bu yug dmar skya'i mdog: phyag gnyis thog ser thogs nas 'brug glog zhon: 'og phyogs klu bdud dud kha sbrul mgo dgu: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags dang ni nad rkyal thogs: sbrul gyi slog pa gsol nas chu srin 'chib: klu mo yaksha nag mo sbrul mjug can: phyag gnyis sbrul gyi zhags pa nad rkyal thogs: sbrul lpags gsol nas ru sbal 'jigs la zhon: shar sgor tshangs pa dkar po bya thul can: spu gri nyi zer thogs nas seng ge zhon: lho sgor rdo rje khyung chen sku mdog dkar: phyag gnyis bdud zhags dang ni spu gri thogs: dom slog gsol nas ba glang sna ring 'chib: nub tu dgra lha rdo rje legs pa dkar: zab slog shel gyi la thod brjid par gsol: rdo rje ru mtshon thogs nas ra dkar 'chib: byang sgor ma hā kā la sku mdog nag: ber nag gsol nas bing chen rked la btsugs: gri thod 'dzin nas rta nag rting dkar 'chib: re re la yang 'khor g.yog 'bum phrag gnyis: phyi nang gsang sbas yang gsang drag sngags dang: las byed btags shing chags pa'i sde brgyad bcas: dug lnga gnas dag ye shes lnga dbang rdzogs: sgo gsum gdod nas rnam dag sku gsung thugs: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros spyan drangs bsam: sha chen gu gul bsregs shing rkang gling 'bud: hūm̐: rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: gdug pa 'dul phyir gsang bdag khros pa'i sku: dregs pa 'dul phyir yab yum 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol: badzra sa mā dza: hūm̐: dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: dregs pa ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: de nas mchod bstod byas la bzlas pa ni: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭān hūm̐ phaṭa:
ces bzlas mchod bstod bzlas bshags rdzogs rim bsgom: de ltar dregs pa'i phrin las shin tu zab: sa ma yaḥrgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya:
